**Issue #3913 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #3913: Patch: card tests read one card's offered plays and targets through testkit helpers, in place of 28 local copies and 130-odd hand-written filters
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Every card has its own tests, and many of them ask the same question: which targets does the game offer for playing this card right now? Each test file answers it with its own few lines, and 28 of them keep a small private helper with a note saying how it differs from the shared one. Once this is built, those tests ask a shared helper instead. There is less test code to read, and a change to how the game lists plays is followed in one place instead of a hundred. Nobody at the table notices; the maintainer and the bot do.

## Why

- 28 card scripts keep a local helper marked “Differs from Scenario::offered”. Among them: `crates/cards/src/scripts/training_grounds/c034_dino_size.rs:64-74`, `core/c056_jilliax.rs:217-227`, `classic_plus/c057_book_of_stats.rs`, `classic/c032_felinor_feelings.rs`, `core/c063_plastic_surgery.rs` and `training_grounds/c002_personal_trainer.rs`. Each takes `legal_actions(s.state(), P1)` and matches `ActionBody::Play { instance_id, targets, .. } if instance_id == X` to unwrap the targets.
- The same narrowing of the legal list to one card's plays, a match arm `ActionBody::Play { … } if instance_id == …`, appears at 134 sites in 102 files under `crates/`. Beside it sit the same narrowing for one card's activations and one attacker's attacks, and hand-written `Selection::Instance` unpacking.
- `Scenario::offered` (`crates/engine/src/testkit/scenario.rs:1354`) returns the seat's whole list, and nothing narrows it to one card. So the copy guard (`crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`, `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS`) meets same-named local helpers, and each had to say how it differs.
- The engine's own `play_actions_for` (`crates/engine/src/play_choices.rs:1898`) is called by no card test.
- The maintainer has taken this shape twice already: prompt Mode options (#3796), and one-target picks, hero picks and card lookups (#3827).

## Proposal

- Add to the testkit's `Scenario`:
  - `plays_of(card) -> Vec<ActionBody>`: the owner's offered plays of that card;
  - `can_play(card) -> bool`;
  - `play_targets(card) -> Vec<Selection>`: the plays' targets, flattened in offer order;
  - `activations_of(card)` and `attacks_of(card)`, in the same shape.
- Add `pick::instance_ids(&[Selection]) -> Vec<String>`.
- Move the 28 local helpers and the hand-written filters onto them. A helper that groups or dedups keeps a one-line map or `.dedup()` on top.
- Register the new names in `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS`, so a new local copy fails the copy guard.

## Where it lands

- `crates/engine/src/testkit/scenario.rs`, `crates/engine/src/testkit/pick.rs`
- `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`
- About 100 test modules under `crates/cards/src/scripts/`, `crates/cards/tests/cross/` and `crates/engine/tests/rules/`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] “Differs from Scenario::offered” matches nothing under `crates/`.
- [ ] A match arm of the form `ActionBody::Play { … } if instance_id ==` appears only in the testkit.
- [ ] Every test keeps its name, so no ruling's proving test moves, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*'` and `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance` pass.
- [ ] Behaviour-neutral: nothing outside test code and the testkit changes.

## Size and risks

Hard by size (about 100 files) but mechanical: roughly 600 lines out and 60 in. The risk is merge conflicts with open card pull requests that touch the same test modules. It can be split by set, as parts n of m, if that suits the queue. A helper of a different shape, such as Jilliax's embiggen and equip flags, builds on `plays_of` and maps the result locally.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Class: `refactor` → `priority:low`; relabel to change it.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43756550831)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Add shared testkit readers for one card's offered plays, play targets, activations and attacks, plus `pick::instance_ids`. Move the 28 `// Differs from Scenario::offered` helpers and the hand-written `ActionBody::Play { … } if instance_id ==` filters onto them. Register the new names in `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS` so a new local copy fails the copy guard.

The change is behaviour-neutral. No test changes name (no ruling's proving test moves), nothing outside test code and the testkit changes, and no new ruling is needed.

Two readings of the acceptance criteria, which I'm recording as decisions:
- **Criterion 2 is scoped to test code that narrows a `legal_actions` list or tests one action.** The arm stays where it reads another list or is not test code: `crates/engine/src/` (outside `testkit/`), `crates/ai/src/{duos,reply,decide}.rs`, `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`, `crates/shared/tests/{duel,practice,daily}.rs` (`host.legal`) and `crates/server/tests/actor/pinned.rs` (`Pinned` legal list). I rejected rewriting them: that is non-test code or a different list, and the change must stay behaviour-neutral.
- **Two helpers go beyond the issue's list.** `plays_in` and `is_play_of` are needed because about 40 sites in `crates/engine/tests/rules` and `crates/ai/tests` hold a raw `GameState` or a single action, not a `Scenario`. Without them criterion 2 cannot be met there.

## Files to touch

| File | | What |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/scenario.rs` | change | free fns `is_play_of`, `plays_in` (beside `prompt_modes_of`, ~l.1213); `Scenario::{plays_of, can_play, play_targets, activations_of, attacks_of}` (beside `offered`, ~l.1363); tests in `mod event_and_action_queries` (~l.3254) |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/pick.rs` | change | `pub fn instance_ids`, header sentence, a small `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/mod.rs` | change | header doc names the new helpers |
| `crates/engine/README.md`, `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` (l.174) | change | add the new names beside `offered(seat)` / `prompt_modes` (the README's `testkit` row, ~l.252) |
| `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs` | change | `PLAY_READERS` const, two `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS` rows, failure-message ids |
| the 28 helper files (below) | change | helper removed or reduced to a one-line map |
| every other file the site search returns (step 6) in `crates/cards/src/scripts/**`, `crates/cards/tests/cross/*`, `crates/engine/tests/rules/*` (incl. `fixtures/`), `crates/ai/tests/ai/*` | change | hand-written filters |

The 28 helper files, under `crates/cards/src/scripts/`:
- **stinkyscape:** c020_tnack_trav, c144_prepare_for_liftoff, c077_yuma, c039_the_narcor_project
- **meditative:** c053_prestige, c018_expedition12
- **classic_plus:** c041_kys_constant, c057_book_of_stats, c072_book_of_nerf, t_ai_01_helpful_assistant
- **meditative_plus:** c022_mountaintop_garden, c025_kys_intuition
- **classic:** c032_felinor_feelings, c053_plague_crawler, c068_small_card_lobbyist, c078_mutate_spell, c048_hired_shrimp, c054_rewind
- **core:** c056_jilliax, c063_plastic_surgery, c082_kys_trial, c049_snom_bunny_mind_control, c007_jewelosco_scarab
- **training_grounds:** c002_personal_trainer, c034_dino_size, c012_fortify, c011_thwomp, c052_snom_bunny_mind_control

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, any non-test code under `crates/*/src` (outside `testkit/`), `crates/shared`, `crates/server`, `crates/tools/src`, `spec/`, `catalog.json`, or `crates/cards/src/patch_history.rs`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`. No spec section or ruling governs this change. Keep every `R<n>` comment and test name exactly as it is, because `cargo jackioh spec check` reads them.

## Steps

Work in this order. Each step leaves the tree green, and the guard row (step 7) goes last.

1. **`scenario.rs`, free fns.** Add after `prompt_modes_of`:
   ```rust
   pub fn is_play_of(action: &ActionBody, card_id: &str) -> bool {
       matches!(action, ActionBody::Play { instance_id, .. } if instance_id == card_id)
   }
   pub fn plays_in(state: &GameState, seat: PlayerId, card_id: &str) -> Vec<ActionBody> {
       crate::reduce::legal_actions(state, seat).into_iter().filter(|a| is_play_of(a, card_id)).collect()
   }
   ```
   Doc them: `plays_in` asks the seat it is given, which a test needs when it holds a state, or checks an opponent's card against p1's list.

2. **`scenario.rs`, methods.** Add to `impl Scenario`, each taking `card: impl Into<CardRef>` and resolving with `self.card(card)` (so a missing card panics, as `card()` does):
   - `plays_of -> Vec<ActionBody>` is `plays_in(&self.current, card.owner, &card.id)`.
   - `can_play -> bool` is `!self.plays_of(card).is_empty()`.
   - `play_targets -> Vec<Selection>` flat-maps each play's `targets.unwrap_or_default()` in offer order.
   - `activations_of -> Vec<ActionBody>` takes `legal_actions(&self.current, card.controller)` and keeps `ActionBody::Activate { instance_id, .. }` equal to the card's id (`ActivatePower` is not included).
   - `attacks_of -> Vec<ActionBody>` does the same for `ActionBody::Attack { attacker_id, .. }`, with `card.controller`.

   Doc the seats: plays use the owner, activations and attacks the controller.

3. **`pick.rs`.** Add `use crate::wire::Selection;` and
   ```rust
   pub fn instance_ids(selections: &[Selection]) -> Vec<String>
   ```
   It is a `filter_map` over `Selection::Instance { instance_id }` that skips hero, mode, zone, craft and none picks. Do not return `Value`, so the pick-builder scan (`PICK_HOME_BUILDERS` = 2) is unaffected. Extend the header comment to mention it.

4. **Testkit tests** (names below). Then run `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --lib` to confirm green.

5. **Migrate the 28 helpers, then the rest of the cards crate.** Use the recipe table below.
   - **Not narrowing legal actions** (they read the open prompt, or build a board): `c077_yuma`, `t_ai_01_helpful_assistant`, `c025_kys_intuition`, `c053_plague_crawler`, `c082_kys_trial`, `c007_jewelosco_scarab`. Their body stays, but rename the fn from `offered` to what it returns (`prompt_def_ids`, `discover_ids`, …) and delete the "Differs from…" note. Where a body unpacks `Selection::Instance`, use `pick::instance_ids`.
   - **Everything else:** delete the helper, call the testkit at its call sites, and keep a one-line map where the shape differs.
     - Jilliax (`(embiggen, equip)`) and Mountaintop Garden (face-up flags, `face_down: None`): map `s.plays_of(X)` through `filter_map(|play| match play { ActionBody::Play { embiggen, equip, .. } => Some((embiggen, equip)), _ => None })`.
     - Tnack Trav, Plastic Surgery and both Snom Bunny files (per-play target lists): map each play to `pick::instance_ids(&targets.unwrap_or_default())`.
     - Narcor Project counts `Activate` plus `ActivatePower`: use `s.activations_of(ID).len()` plus a `matches!(…ActivatePower…)` count over `s.offered(P1)`, or keep its filter on `ActivatePower` only.
     - Personal Trainer and Mutate Spell dedup: `Vec::dedup` only drops adjacent repeats, so keep first-seen order with `IndexSet` (re-exported by the testkit), or `sort(); dedup()` if the test compares sorted.

6. **Remaining Play sites.** List them with the Grep tool, `multiline: true`: `ActionBody::Play \{[^}]*\}\)?,?\s*if \*?&?(instance_id|id)\s*==` (also `\bid\b` forms), path `crates`, glob `*.rs`. Skip the out-of-scope files named in the Goal. Recipes:

   | Old | New |
   |---|---|
   | `legal_actions(s.state(), P1)` filtered to a card, `.collect()` | `s.plays_of(c)` |
   | `.any(..)` / `.find(..).is_some()` | `s.can_play(c)` |
   | `.filter(..).count()` | `s.plays_of(c).len()` |
   | `.find(..).expect("a play")` | `must(s.plays_of(c).into_iter().next(), "a play of …")` |
   | flat-mapped `targets` | `s.play_targets(c)` (ids: `pick::instance_ids(&…)`) |
   | the card is the opponent's, or the seat is not its owner (`theirs` asked of p1) | `plays_in(s.state(), P1, &id)`. **Never `plays_of`**: the opponent is not active, so the check would pass vacuously. |
   | test holds only a `GameState` | `plays_in(&state, seat, &id)`; `.any(..)` becomes `!plays_in(..).is_empty()` |
   | an arm on one action (AI decision, log entry, `DuosActionBody::Duel { body }`) | `is_play_of(action, id)` |
   | extra field (`x: Some(2)`, `embiggen: Some(true)`, `face_down: Some(_)`, `zone: Some(_)`) | narrow with `plays_of`/`plays_in`, then `.iter().any(\|p\| matches!(p, ActionBody::Play { x: Some(2), .. }))` with no `instance_id` comparison |
   | `Activate` / `Attack` arm where a `Scenario` is held | `s.activations_of(c)` / `s.attacks_of(c)` (best effort; not an acceptance item) |

   Cautions:
   - `s.plays_of("def-id")` resolves the first card with that def id. Where the old code looped over several copies (`c053_prestige` checks every held Prestige), loop instances: `s.hand("p1").iter().any(|c| c.def_id == PRESTIGE && s.can_play(c))`.
   - `plays_of(state, id, player)` in `fixtures/play_pipeline_b.rs` has its arguments in a different order from `plays_in(state, seat, id)`. Fix each caller.
   - After each file, remove imports that became unused (`legal_actions`, `Selection`, `ActionBody`, `PlayerId`). Clippy runs with `-D warnings`.
   - `crates/ai/tests` imports testkit names explicitly (`ai/tests/ai/support.rs`), so add `is_play_of` and `plays_in` there.

   Order: cards scripts, then `crates/cards/tests/cross`, then `crates/engine/tests/rules`, then `crates/ai/tests`. Run each crate's tests after its group.

7. **Guard, `acceptance.rs`.** Add
   ```rust
   const PLAY_READERS: &[&str] = &["crates/cards/src/scripts", "crates/cards/tests", "crates/engine/tests", "crates/ai/tests"];
   ```
   It must not be the whole `crates/cards`, because `patch_history.rs` has a `plays_of`. Add two rows to `SHARED_TEST_HELPERS`, copying the shape of the existing `scenario.rs` row:
   - Row A: home `crates/engine/src/testkit/scenario.rs`, names `["plays_of", "can_play", "play_targets", "activations_of", "attacks_of", "plays_in", "is_play_of"]`, dirs `PLAY_READERS`, `more_than: 1000`.
   - Row B: home `crates/engine/src/testkit/pick.rs`, names `["instance_ids"]`, dirs `["crates/cards/src/scripts", "crates/cards/tests", "crates/ai/tests"]`, `more_than: 1000`. It must exclude `crates/engine/tests`, where about 12 unrelated event-reading `instance_ids` fns live.

   Add `#3913` to the failure message's id list. Then run `cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance`; its failure prints every `path:line` copy. For each one: if it is the same shape, migrate it onto the helper; if its body differs, rename it (for example `plays_of(events)` becomes `plays_made`) and leave the body alone.

8. **Docs.** Add the new names to `crates/engine/README.md`, `crates/engine/src/testkit/mod.rs` and `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` l.174 (read plays through `plays_of`, `can_play` and `play_targets`, and use `plays_in` for a held state). Say that the acceptance scan refuses a copy of a name under the listed trees.

## Tests

- **`crates/engine/src/testkit/scenario.rs`, `mod event_and_action_queries`** (fixtures: `core-025`, 4 mana, a unit; `core-056` Jilliax; `anchor()`):
  - `plays_of_lists_one_cards_plays_for_its_owner`: every entry is a play of that card, and the list equals `s.offered(P1)` filtered by `is_play_of`.
  - `can_play_follows_what_the_owner_can_pay`: false at 3 mana, true at 4.
  - `plays_in_asks_the_seat_it_is_given_and_is_play_of_names_one_card`: `plays_in(.., P1, id)` equals `plays_of`; `plays_in(.., P2, id)` is empty.
  - `attacks_of_lists_one_units_attacks`: a ready unit has an attack on the enemy hero, and another unit's attacks are not included.
- **`crates/engine/src/testkit/pick.rs`**: `instance_ids_keeps_instance_picks_in_order_and_skips_the_rest`, using an Instance, a `Hero { player }`, a `Mode { option }` and a second Instance.
- **`crates/cards/src/scripts/training_grounds/c011_thwomp.rs`, `mod base`**: `the_testkit_flattens_every_plays_targets_in_offer_order`. It uses the existing `board(false, json!([GREASER]), json!([GREASER]))`. It asserts `s.play_targets(THWOMP)` equals the concatenation of each play's `targets` from `s.plays_of(THWOMP)`, and that the result is non-empty.
- **`crates/cards/tests/cross/activate_listed.rs`**: `the_testkit_lists_one_cards_activations`. On a board with exactly one activatable card, `s.activations_of(card)` equals `s.offered(P1)` filtered to `ActionBody::Activate`, and is non-empty.

Commands:
```
cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --lib event_and_action_queries
cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --lib instance_ids
cargo test -p jackioh-cards
cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*'
cargo test -p jackioh-ai
cargo test -p jackioh-tools --test acceptance
cargo fmt
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo jackioh spec check
cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims
```
(`cargo fmt` only reformats what you changed, since `main` is already formatted.)

## Done when

- [ ] Grep for `Differs from Scenario::offered` under `crates/` finds nothing.
- [ ] The multiline Play-arm search finds nothing but `scenario.rs` and the out-of-scope files named in the Goal.
- [ ] `plays_of`, `can_play`, `play_targets`, `activations_of`, `attacks_of`, `plays_in`, `is_play_of` and `pick::instance_ids` exist, with the tests above.
- [ ] Both guard rows are registered, the acceptance test passes, and every renamed same-name fn keeps its body.
- [ ] No test changed name, was ignored or deleted, or had its assertions weakened.
- [ ] The three docs are updated.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, the engine rules tests, `jackioh-ai`, `jackioh-tools --test acceptance`, the `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` checks all pass.
- [ ] The full `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` run leaves `apps/web/src/wire` clean.

## Risks

- **Vacuous assertions.** `plays_of` asks the card's owner, who is not active when the card is the opponent's, so it returns an empty list. A "not offered" test on an opponent's or other seat's card must use `plays_in` with the old seat (step 6).
- **Wrong card picked.** A def-id lookup takes the first match, so a multi-copy loop must stay per instance.
- **Order-dependent dedup.** See step 5's dedup note.
- **Name clashes.** The guard rows fail on same-named local fns. Step 7's printed list is the source of truth; rename a differently shaped one, don't delete it.
- **Merge conflicts** with open card PRs touching the same test modules. If the run is cut off, the steps are ordered so each stage is green, and the harness can continue from the last one.
- **Purity and replay.** Nothing in `crates/engine/src` outside `testkit/` changes. The helpers are read-only over `legal_actions`, so determinism, replay and hidden information are untouched.

## Open questions

None blocks the build. Maintainer calls to confirm:
- Is it acceptable that `ai/src`, `tools/src/fuzz.rs` and the shared/server tests keep the arm (see Goal)?
- Should this land as one PR, or split by set ("parts n of m") if the run runs out of budget? I planned one PR, with the guard row last.
````
